title: Wayland: Segmentation fault on game window close (gdb backtrace included)
body:
### Tested versions

Latest master

### System information

Godot v4.6.beta (79603b2f2) - Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS 24.04 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6600 (RADV NAVI23) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 15.51 GiB memory

### Issue description

Segmentation fault when closing the game window on Wayland. 

### Steps to reproduce

This happens randomly when I press stop from Godot main editor window when the game is running in a separate window. A bit finicky to reproduce, so I've been running godot in `gdb` to catch it. Here's the relevant backtraces etc.
